name: The Package Day
source:
Help out on delivering packages with Andreas!

The Package Day is a made-up holiday in a visual novel, where people send their loved ones packages. Delivery people have it hard at this day. See how Raphael helps out Andreas on delivery service!

Experience a cozy life between them and so much more!

[From [url=https://peppekzmagimerlin.itch.io/the-package-day]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
与安德烈亚斯一起帮忙运送包裹！

包裹日是视觉小说中虚构的节日，人们在这一天给亲人寄包裹。快递员这一天过得很辛苦。看看Raphael如何帮助Andreas提供送货服务！

体验他们之间的温馨生活等等！

[来自[url=https://peppekzmagimerlin.itch.io/the-package-day]Itch.io[/url]]
